items.label: Cloud-Like Comfort
items.value: Featuring 3D cutting technology, the memory foam sofa is filled with 30D elastic foam, providing excellent support and resilience for a more comfortable seating experience. Experience cloud-like comfort the moment you sit down

items.label: No assembly required
items.value: Say goodbye to complicated assembly! Simply unbox your boneless L shape sectional couch, position the modules, we recommend allowing 36-48 hours to fully fluff up, and gently pat each section to expands to its full glory

items.label: Multiple Package
items.value: Your new modular sectional sofa arrives in 2 separate, manageable boxes. Please note that shipments may arrive on different days, but everything you need is on its way for your convenience setup experience

items.label: Modular & Customizable
items.value: ‌ our boneless sectional couch can be reconfigured to adapt to changing space needs. Whether in a bedroom, apartment or living room, the layout can be adjusted to maximize space utilization, making it ideal for many activities

items.label: Extra-Long Fabric
items.value: Indulge in our comfy corduroy couch crafted with precision weaving, offering a silky-smooth touch. The 0.1-inch extra-long corduroy fabric strikes a perfect balance between softness and breathability, ensuring lasting comfort

items.label: Spacious Deep Seating
items.value: our compressed sofa has a total width of 96 inches, offering limitless luxurious space possibilities for family movie nights, gatherings with friends, or solo relaxation. The L-shaped design allows legs to stretch naturally
